selection.summary: OCI storage backend configuration parsing/validation issue addressed via source patch. (1) Validation: internal/config/storage.go validate() only called registry.ParseReference, which fails to reject unsupported schemes (e.g. unknown://registry/repo:tag, per h8 fixture and h3 ParseReference which enforces scheme in [http|https|flipt] with a clear 'unexpected repository scheme' error). Patch additionally calls oci.ParseReference for repositories containing '://', wrapping errors as 'validating OCI configuration: %w', consistent with existing tests (h1/h19/h24/h25). (2) Parsing: added PollInterval field (mapstructure/yaml 'poll_interval') to the OCI struct (h0/h13/h20) next to the already-present BundleDirectory 'bundles_directory' (h28) and Authentication fields, with viper default 'storage.oci.poll_interval' = 30s (h15/h21), matching the 30s default in internal/storage/fs/oci/source.go NewSource and its WithPollInterval option (h2). (3) Schema: config/flipt.schema.cue (h6) and config/flipt.schema.json (h17) lacked bundles_directory and poll_interval in the oci section; both were updated to declare them (poll_interval duration-or-integer, default '30s'), matching the provided fixture h9. Limitation: no wiring site constructing the OCI backend from StorageConfig exists in this snapshot, so PollInterval-to-backend option hookup could not be patched; only parse/validate/schema scope is verified.
